camel_example: aliyun iot BatchUnbindDeviceFromEdgeInstance --region cn-hangzhou --IotIds.1 BXPV9Ks3bxwM9fD00000000101 --InstanceId F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000
description_en: Removes multiple devices from an edge instance
description_zh: 批量将设备从边缘实例中移除
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-unbind-device-from-edge-instance --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --iot-ids BXPV9Ks3bxwM9fD00000000101 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchUnbindDeviceFromEdgeInstance

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You do not need to specify this parameter for public instances. You must specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The edge instance ID. To obtain the ID, go to the Edge Instances page in the Link IoT Edge console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list) and move the pointer over the name of the target edge instance.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of device IDs. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html operation to query all devices under the current account and obtain the device IDs.

You can remove a maximum of 20 devices in a single call
parameters.help_zh:
设备ID列表。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69905.html查询当前账号下所有设备信息，获取设备IotId。

单次调用最多可移除20个设备
parameters.name: iot_ids
